firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently visited a zoo goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: That player receives the Megaphone and takes the first communication turn. Turns proceed clockwise in this cooperative game.
